verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents built-in RAG that retrieves relevant information from local and remote documents and incorporates it into chat responses, so the core of grounded answers over your own documents is a first-party capability. Two hands-on reports say RAG did not work for them without a GPU when using only external APIs. That is a limitation of one configuration, not a contradiction of the feature. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a persistent, reusable knowledge-base collection; support for personal notes; citation of sources in document answers; reliable RAG in CPU-only or API-only deployments.

support.subject: As a power user, I can attach my own documents and notes as a knowledge base and get grounded answers over them

citations.quote: retrieving relevant information from a wide range of sources such as local and remote documents, web content, and even multimedia sources like YouTube videos.
RAG can retrieve and incorporate the relevant information from that source into the chat response.
a rather unique combination of advanced features (RAG integrations, workspaces, pipelines, code execution, MCP integration, etc.)
